summary.text: Rob Martwick is a member of the Illinois Senate for the 10th Legislative District, appointed on June 28, 2019.
He previously served in the Illinois House of Representatives from 2013 to 2019, representing the 19th House District.

paragraphs.text: Martwick was raised in Norridge and earned a Bachelor of Arts in economics from Boston College in 1988 and a law degree from The John Marshall Law School in 1996.
His site says that in 1993, while still in law school, he ran for Trustee of Norwood Park Township and served one four-year term.
Martwick is an attorney and former criminal prosecutor who worked as an Assistant State's Attorney and later practiced real estate taxation law.
His biography says he lives in the Portage Park neighborhood of Chicago with his wife, Sharon, and their sons.
